description: Complete Jobs flow (JOB-01, JOB-02, JOB-03), Business Storefront (BIZ-01), Compare page enhancements, and global polish: implement Jobs list with filters, Job detail with company header, apply modal (Quick Apply + Full Profile), Business profile with cover/logo/verified badge/description/listings/reviews/staff, complete Compare page side-by-side table, add global shared components (AuthGate bottom sheet, Confirm Dialog, Toast notifications), implement empty states on all list pages, feature flags (ENABLE_MONETIZATION, ENABLE_JOBS, ENABLE_AUCTIONS, ENABLE_BARTER), offline draft notice, and suspension notice.
steps: 1. Complete JobsPage (JOB-01): job list with search bar, filters (category, location, salary range, job type), job cards showing company logo, title, location, salary, posted date, type badge, save job heart, 'Apply Now' button; filter by job type (government/private/freelance/remote); empty state if no results.

2. Implement JobDetailPage (JOB-02): company header (logo, name, website), job title, full description, requirements list, benefits list, 'Apply Now' button (opens apply modal), 'Save Job' button (heart toggle), applicant count, posted/deadline dates, company info section.

3. Implement ApplyModal (JOB-03): two options: 'Quick Apply' (name + phone + message textarea) or 'Full Profile' (CV file upload + cover letter textarea); radio toggle between options, form validation, submit button.

4. Create BusinessProfilePage (BIZ-01): header with cover image (gradient if missing), logo + business name, verified badge (if exists), description, categories served (chip list), contact info (phone, email, address), listings section (grid of latest listings), reviews section (list format), staff section (3-5 staff cards with avatar + name + role mocked), follow button (toggle), message button.

5. Enhance ComparePage: two-column sticky header showing selected listings (image + title + price per column), scrollable table below with rows: Price, Location, Condition, + all unique specs from listings; highlight differences (bold + background color), 'Remove from Compare' button per column, 'Clear All' button, side-by-side layout works on mobile via horizontal scroll.

6. Create global AuthGateSheet component: bottom sheet modal triggered on gated actions (message, offer, chat without login); shows sign-in options (Email/Google/Facebook/Apple), 'Sign up' link, 'Cancel' button; non-dismissible except via button.
7. Create global ConfirmDialog component: title, message, confirm button, cancel button, danger variant (red confirm button); used for delete/mark sold/report confirmations.
8. Enhance Toast component (if needed): position at top-right (ltr) / top-left (rtl), auto-hide after 3s, support severity (info/success/warning/error), stacked if multiple toasts.
9. Add global empty states: all list pages (Favorites, Saved Searches, My Listings, Jobs, etc.) show EmptyState (icon + title + description + optional action button) if data is empty.
10. Implement feature flags in AppContext: ENABLE_MONETIZATION, ENABLE_JOBS, ENABLE_AUCTIONS, ENABLE_BARTER (all true for Phase 2 but flag-gated pages); wrap page render in flag check.
11. Add Suspended Account notice: full-screen overlay if user.status === 'suspended' (from mock AuthContext); message + support link, no escape.
12. Add Maintenance/Force Update screen (ComingSoonPage variant): triggers if version mismatch (mock check); blocks all navigation except logout.
13. Add offline draft notice: bar at top of AddListingPage if networkState === 'offline'; shows alert icon + 'Offline mode: changes saved locally'; auto-hide after 5s.
14. Add deep link support: ensure /listing/:id, /seller/:name, /jobs/:id, /business/:id all work and pre-load correct data.
15. Ensure all screens support AR/EN, responsive, proper error states, loading skeletons, keyboard navigation, WCAG basics (semantic HTML, ARIA labels on icon buttons).
acceptance_criteria: JobsPage renders list of jobs, filters work (type, location, salary), empty state if no results, save job heart toggles, 'Apply Now' opens modal.
JobDetailPage shows full job details, company info, requirements, benefits, 'Apply Now' and 'Save Job' buttons functional.
ApplyModal has Quick Apply and Full Profile options, form validation, submit success toast.
BusinessProfilePage shows cover image, logo, business name, verified badge, description, categories served, listings grid, reviews, staff list, follow button toggles, message button functional.
ComparePage shows two-column sticky header, scrollable table with specs, differences highlighted, remove/clear buttons work, responsive on mobile with horizontal scroll.
AuthGateSheet appears on message/offer/chat without login, shows social options, sign-up link, cancel button, non-dismissible except via button.
ConfirmDialog shows on delete/mark sold/report, confirm/cancel buttons work, danger variant shows red button.
Toast appears at top-right (ltr) / top-left (rtl), auto-hides after 3s, multiple toasts stack.
Empty states render on all list pages (Favorites, Saved Searches, My Listings, Jobs, etc.) with icon, title, description, action button.
Feature flags control page visibility; ENABLE_JOBS flag hides Jobs if false, etc.
Suspended account shows full-screen notice, no escape; Maintenance screen blocks navigation.
Offline draft notice bar appears on AddListingPage when offline.
Deep links work: /listing/lst-001 loads detail, /seller/Demo%20User loads profile, /jobs/job-001 loads job, /business/biz-001 loads business.
All screens AR/EN responsive, loading states, error states, proper keyboard navigation, semantic HTML with ARIA labels.
verification: npm run dev — navigate to /jobs; verify job list loads, filters work, save job heart toggles, click 'Apply Now' → modal opens with Quick Apply and Full Profile options.
Click job card → /jobs/:id detail page loads, company info displays, click 'Apply Now' → apply modal, submit → success toast.
Navigate to /business/biz-001 (or valid ID) → business profile loads, cover + logo + name + verified badge, listings grid, reviews, staff, follow + message buttons functional.
Navigate to /compare with 2-3 listings pre-selected → compare page shows sticky header with listings, table below with specs, differences highlighted, remove/clear buttons work.
Logout and try to message/offer → AuthGateSheet appears with sign-in options, click 'Sign up' → /register, cancel → sheet closes.
Delete action → ConfirmDialog appears, confirm → success, cancel → no-op.
On /add-listing, toggle offline (DevTools Network) → offline draft notice appears.
Switch AR → all text translates, layout mirrors (flex, text-align, badge position, sheet alignment).
Test keyboard navigation: Tab through all interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs), Enter/Space activate buttons, Esc closes modals (where applicable).
